title: Rules of Court 2021
obtained_how: Two GET requests with Python urllib to Singapore Statutes Online, User-Agent a desktop-browser string, 15 seconds apart: the instrument page (?WholeDoc=1), then the page's own lazy-load call (/Details/GetLazyLoadContent) for the root fragment, which returns the whole body. The .html file is that fragment unedited; the .txt file is the fragment with tags stripped (etc/fetch-sso.py of legalese/l4-ide, copied with /Act/ changed to /SL/). The fetch was made outside the 3 a.m. to 7 a.m. window of SSO Terms of Use cl.13(d)(i), on Meng Weng Wong's ruling of 2026-11-05 that a targeted fetch of fewer than 20 documents may be made at any hour with 15 seconds between requests; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md.
text_caveat: SSO reproduces an unofficial consolidation; the text is tag-stripped HTML, so tables and forms lose their layout.
